form.label: 4. Network Correlation — ISE / DNA Center
form.description: Line up identity (ISE), assurance (DNA Center) and the wire (switches) into one incident timeline instead of three separate consoles.

html.blockquote: "Fehlende Korrelationen der Netzwerkkomponenten wie ISE, DNA usw."
html.p: ISE, DNA Center, switches and wireless controllers each tell part of the story — an auth failure here, a client health score drop there, an interface flap somewhere else — but nobody looks at them together. This lab already demonstrates the correlation pattern (see the Correlation app's 2/3-source dashboards) across the systems that exist here; this view applies the same idea to ISE + DNA Center + the access layer, which is exactly what the customer is missing.

panel.title: Data sources needed to build this for real

ul.li: Cisco ISE — via pxGrid or syslog: authentication success/failure, posture status, and endpoint profiling, keyed by MAC/username.
Cisco DNA Center — Assurance API (or syslog): client health score, network device health, and issue events, keyed by client MAC or device.

Switch / router syslog & SNMP — interface up/down, port-security violations, spanning-tree events (this lab already has an SSH-poll pattern for Cisco Catalyst devices in Get Data In → SSH Devices that generalizes to this).
Wireless LAN controller — client roam/deauth events for wireless endpoints.
Common correlation key: MAC address (or username, for identity-based correlation) — the same "correlate by" technique used elsewhere in this lab.

panel.title: Auth failures linked to a network-health drop
Mean time to correlate — before vs. with Splunk

search.query: | makeresults count=5 | streamstats count as i | eval Time=strftime(relative_time(now(), "-".(300-i*40)."s"), "%H:%M:%S") | eval Source=case(i=1,"ISE",i=2,"Switch (access layer)",i=3,"DNA Center",i=4,"ISE",i=5,"DNA Center") | eval Event=case( i=1,"802.1X auth failed (cert expired) — endpoint 3rd-floor-nurse-station-07", i=2,"Gi1/0/24 err-disabled (port-security violation)", i=3,"Client health score dropped 92 -> 34 for endpoint 3rd-floor-nurse-station-07", i=4,"Endpoint re-authenticated after cert renewal", i=5,"Client health score recovered 34 -> 90") | eval Device="3rd-floor-nurse-station-07 (AA:BB:CC:11:22:33)" | table Time Source Event Device | sort Time

panel.title: Client health score around the incident (DNA Center)

search.query: | makeresults count=20 | streamstats count as i | eval Minute=strftime(relative_time(now(), "-".(20-i)."m"), "%H:%M") | eval "Client health score"=case(i>=9 AND i<=13, 34, 1=1, 90+(i%3)) | table Minute "Client health score"

| makeresults count=20 | streamstats count as i | eval Minute=strftime(relative_time(now(), "-".(20-i)."m"), "%H:%M") | eval "Auth success"=if(i>=9 AND i<=12,0,1) | eval "Auth failure"=if(i>=9 AND i<=12,1,0) | table Minute "Auth success" "Auth failure"

panel.title: The SPL, once ISE + DNA Center are onboarded (same pattern as this lab's 3-source correlation)

html.pre: (index=ise_logs OR index=dnac_assurance OR index=network_syslog) | eval mac=coalesce(mac, endpoint_mac, client_mac) | eval source=case(index="ise_logs","ISE", index="dnac_assurance","DNA Center", index="network_syslog","Switch") | stats count(eval(source=="ISE")) as ise_events, count(eval(source=="DNA Center")) as dnac_events, count(eval(source=="Switch")) as switch_events, min(_time) as first_event, max(_time) as last_event by mac | where ise_events>0 AND (dnac_events>0 OR switch_events>0) | eval duration_sec=last_event-first_event
html.p: This is the exact "correlate two/three sources by a shared key" pattern already built into the Correlation app in this lab — swap the indexes and the key stays the same.
